binning_policy: Count the same 4 eta by 5 pT grid as in 2024, then merge exactly to eta [0,0.9,1.2,2.4] and pT [5,10] for the final fit.
denominator_selection: reconstructed tracker muon with 5 < pT < 10 GeV and abs(eta) < 2.4, without a LooseID or mini-isolation requirement

mc_reference.policy: Use the identically selected high-statistics reference MC because no equivalent target-year SPS double-J/psi NanoAOD production exists; the target-year data histograms are unchanged. Future POG validation of this cross-year simulation reference is required.

probe_binning_reduction.method: exact selection and sum of existing pass/fail mass histograms

tag_selection: tight muon with pT > 5 GeV; no mini-isolation or trigger-object requirement is applied to either measured J/psi leg
target_selection: looseId; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
